visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white bicolored cat is seen from behind walking across a light-colored carpeted floor in a home. The cat moves towards a dark wood door at the end of a short hallway. To the left, there is a wooden structure and a pair of blue sandals on the floor. (2) The cat approaches a second tabby cat lying near the door. As the orange cat gets closer, the tabby cat immediately rolls over onto its side and then its back, exposing its belly. The orange cat stands firmly over the submissive tabby cat. (3) The orange cat puts its full weight onto the tabby cat, pinning it down. The tabby cat's legs are splayed in the air, and its head is tilted back. The orange cat begins to aggressively groom the tabby cat's neck and jaw area. (4) Close-up shot showing the orange cat's face burying into the tabby's fur. The tabby cat moves its head from side to side and pushes against the orange cat's chest with its paws, appearing to try and wriggle free from the intense pinning. (5) The orange cat continues to hold its position on top of the tabby cat. The camera angle shifts to show the struggle more clearly, with the orange cat's white fur contrasting against the darker tabby patterns. White variety-show style text overlays appear centrally. (6) A final close-up shot focuses on the orange cat's face from a very low angle. The cat has a white muzzle and orange markings on its head and ears. It stares intensely at something off-camera with wide green eyes, looking slightly disgruntled.
